oneOf.description: An observation lists it as it is now.
It changed after the observation that lists it (`example-stale`).

IncludeKind.description: What kind of directive includes it.

LeftOut.description: Why a build leaves a page out (SPEC §9.3).

oneOf.description: The page's `variant` names none of the values the build selects.
The page's `available` makes it unavailable for the build.

LspPosition.description:
A position in a document: a zero-based line, and a zero-based column in
the position encoding the client and server agreed on.

character.description: The column, from 0, in the negotiated position encoding.

LspRange.description: A range in a document, from `start` up to (not including) `end`.

PageAbout.description: What a page or fragment is.

address.description:
Its address, from the host's root, as the site output's links write
it; `null` for a fragment.

availability.description: Its own `available`, as shown; `null` when it has none.

builds.description:
Whether each build publishes it, in declaration order; empty for a
fragment, which is published only where it's included.

description.description:
Its description, when its type gives a field the description role;
`null` for a fragment.

fragment.description: Whether it's a fragment, which is published only where it's included.

listing.description:
Whether it's listed, and what sets that; `null` for a fragment and
for a page no build publishes.

markdownAddress.description:
Its Markdown version's address, from the host's root, when the
project publishes one (`[consumer] agents = true`); `null` otherwise,
and for a fragment.

permalinks.description: The permalinks the file declares, in document order.

review.description:
When it's due for review, when its type gives a field the
review-date role and the page has a date in it.

template.description:
What its type's template still leaves to fill in; `null` when its
type has no template or nothing of it is left.

type.description:
Its content type; `null` for a fragment, and when no one type
applies.

PageBuild.description: Whether a build publishes the page.

leftOut.description: Why the build leaves the page out; `null` when it publishes it.

PageDescription.description: A page's description, measured against its line in `llms.txt`.

field.description: The frontmatter field the page's type gives the description role.

length.description:
Its length in characters, as plain text on one line, as
`description-too-long` measures it: the page's own, or its field's
default when it leaves the field out or empty. `null` when it has
none, which is where `page-description-missing` reports it.

range.description:
The field's line, or the page's first line when it has none, in the
negotiated position encoding.

reported.description:
Whether `description-too-long` reports it: it's over `limit`, and the
project hasn't turned the check off. A default is reported where
`ascribe.toml` writes it.

PageExample.description: A tested example a `@snippet` of the file shows.

range.description: The `@snippet` line, in the negotiated position encoding.

state.description: Whether it's tested as it is now.

tested.description: What it was tested with, when it's tested.

id.description: Its source id: its `@id`, or its slug.

range.description: The heading line, in the negotiated position encoding.

text.description:
Its text as plain text, with each declared phrase replaced by its
value.

PageHealth.description: How a page stands: its size, and its tested examples.

examples.description:
Each `@snippet` of the file that shows a tested example, in
document order.

size.description:
Its plain Markdown's size in the build where it's largest; `null`
for a fragment, and for a page no build publishes.

PageInclude.description: What a file includes: a fragment, or a snippet of a code file.

path.description:
The file it shows: a fragment's content path, or a code file's path
from the project root; `null` when the address names no file.

range.description: The directive line, in the negotiated position encoding.

PageListing.description: Whether search engines list a page, and what sets that.

build.description:
The build it's read from: the editor's build when it publishes the
page, and otherwise the first that does.

from.description:
What sets it, as `pages.json`'s `listing_from.level` says: `default`,
`page`, `site`, `older-lines`, `folder`, or `type`.

range.description: Where in that file, in the negotiated position encoding.

rule.description: The rule of `[listing]` that sets it, as written; `null` otherwise.

uri.description:
The `file:` URI of the file that sets it: the page for its own
`listing`, `ascribe.toml` for a rule; `null` when nothing does.

body.description:
Where its text starts, in the memo file, in the negotiated position
encoding.

firstLine.description: The first line of its text that isn't blank.

path.description: Its path from the project root.

personal.description:
Whether it's a personal memo, kept in `.ascribe/memos/` on this
machine only.

state.description: `placed`, or `outdated` when no block holds its quote.

PagePermalink.description: A permalink declared in the file (SPEC §7.5).

heading.description: The text of the heading it leads to; `null` for the page's own.

range.description:
The page's `permalink` line, or the heading's `@id` line, in the
negotiated position encoding.
The link or the directive line, in the negotiated position encoding.

text.description: The text of the line it starts on, trimmed.

uri.description: The `file:` URI of the file it's written in.

PageReview.description: When a page is due for review.

days.description:
The days from today to the date: negative once it's passed. `null`
when the server has no day to count from.

field.description: The frontmatter field with the review-date role.

range.description: The field's line, in the negotiated position encoding.

reported.description:
Whether `review-overdue` reports the page: the date has passed, and
the project hasn't turned the check off.

PageSize.description: A page's size, as `page-size` measures it.

build.description: The build it's that size in: the first of the largest.

limit.description: The size `page-size` reports it at; `null` when the check is off.

PageTemplate.description: What a page's template still leaves to fill in.

left.description:
How many placeholders and template values are left, as
`template-placeholder-left` finds them.

type.description: The content type whose template it is.

description:
The answer to `ascribe/page`. A document that isn't a page or a fragment
of the project gets an empty answer: no `about`, no heading, and empty
lists.

about.description:
What the page is; `null` when the document isn't a page or a
fragment.

heading.description:
The heading whose section holds the cursor, the innermost one with an
id; `null` when the cursor is in none, and the lists are then about
the whole file.

health.description:
How the page stands: its size and its tested examples. Empty when
the document isn't a page or a fragment.

includedBy.description:
The `@include`s of the file, or of the heading's section, in the
same order.

includes.description: The file's `@include`s and `@snippet`s, in document order.

linkedFrom.description:
The links to the heading, or to the file when there's no heading:
from other files, and, for a heading, from its own page and from a
page that includes it. File by file in content path order, and in
document order within a file.

memos.description:
The memo files about the heading, or about the file when there's no
heading, or about a block in it (SPEC §7.7): the committed ones, then
the personal ones, each in path order. A detached memo isn't listed.

title: PageResult
